title: Phase 3: Source Tracking & Multi-Provider Rendering
description:
**Projects and issues carry source metadata. The UI adapts based on provider capabilities.**

## Tasks (from original ticket)

- [ ] Generalize workspace model — add `provider` field and generic `credentials` object instead of Linear-specific token fields
- [ ] Capability-aware rendering in `render.js` — gate "Add task" on `write`; dynamic "View in {displayName} →"; gate Comments on `comments`; gate estimates on `estimates`
- [ ] Capability-aware prompts — skip MCP/Linear refs off-Linear; skip subtask formatting unsupported; adjust workflow on `write`
- [ ] Update auth routes to store provider-aware workspace objects

## Risk: Medium (rendering + minor UI text). Re-grounded as Medium-High — see blast radius below.

---

# PLAN (re-grounded at HEAD `caf1031` ≡ main `45bf490`)

## Strategy framing — chosen: **B (close the gap, sequenced) → breakdown**

This is a convergence/migration epic ([LIN-174](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-174/backend-provider-abstraction)) with concrete next providers queued: [LIN-178](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-178/phase-4-github-issues-provider) (GitHub), [LIN-179](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-179/phase-5-staticlocal-providers) (Static/Local), peer [LIN-275](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-275/jira-integration) (Jira). Cost-of-not-doing the workspace-model generalization is a real **workaround tax**: every later provider inherits a Linear-token-shaped workspace and pays a per-provider branch at **29** `workspace.accessToken` **read sites** + the hardcoded Linear display strings. No existing ticket owns "generalize workspace credentials," so deferring it (strategies C/D) would route around an **untracked** contract gap — explicitly disallowed here. Cost-of-doing is high-but-not-prohibitive (wide-but-mechanical migration with a clear back-compat read path), so per the default we **close the gap**. It does not fit one session → decompose into the sequenced surfaces below.

> Rejected: **A** (full pass) — fails session-fit. **C/D** (defer model/auth) — leave the Linear-token workspace shape in place with **no inheritor ticket** ("none identified"), which the framing rules forbid unless cost is prohibitive; it isn't.

## ⚠️ Key re-grounding finding — the ticket's capability vocabulary does not exist yet

The Phase-2 `capabilities` descriptor (`lib/providers/interface.js`) is **method-keyed** — derived by diffing prototype overrides against `PROVIDER_SURFACE` (`fetchProjects`, `createIssue`, …). It exposes `capabilities.fetchIssueComments`, `capabilities.createIssue`, etc. It does **not** expose the abstract flags the ticket assumes (`write`, `comments`, `estimates`, `subtasks`) or a human display name. Naively reading them regresses Linear:

* `write`: Linear's writes (`createIssue` …) are *declared-but-unimplemented this phase* → `linearProvider.supports('createIssue') === false`. Gating "+ Add task" on that would **hide it for Linear** — a regression. The "+ Add task" link actually depends on `getCreateTaskUrl` (implemented), not `createIssue`. "Write" for UI must be defined deliberately, not read from the method descriptor.
* `comments`: `fetchIssueComments` is implemented → maps cleanly.
* `estimates`: no method, no descriptor entry — `issue.estimate` is just a field. Flag must be invented.
* `subtasks`: no method/flag — children flow through generic `formatChildren`. Flag must be invented.
* `displayName`: does not exist. Provider only has machine `name='linear'`. Must be added.

➡️ This forces a **prerequisite interface-extension surface (S0)** that all rendering/prompt surfaces depend on. It is where the real design decision lives.

Also note: prompts **already** have a `linearMcp`/`useLinear` toggle (`formatWorkflow` et al. gate `' in Linear'` on `includeLinear = useLinear ?? useMcp ?? true`) — but it's a *user feature-flag*, not provider-derived, and it only strips `' in Linear'` suffixes, leaving `## Update Linear` section headers and \~55 template-def strings hardcoded. S4/S5 = wire provider capability into existing plumbing **and** cover the un-flagged strings.

Decide access pattern (dedicated `provider.ui = {write, comments, estimates, subtasks, displayName}` vs overloading `supports()`). Define `write` for UI as "has create/getCreateTaskUrl affordance," NOT the unimplemented `createIssue`. | n/a (defines it) | → S3,S4,S5 |
| **S1** | `lib/workspace.js` (typedef + helpers), not `routes/workspace.js` (which only does remove/redirect) | Add `provider` field + generic `credentials` object; add a back-compat accessor that reads both new `credentials.token` and legacy `accessToken`. | n/a | → S2,S3,S(readers) |
| **S2** | `routes/auth.js` (L155-163 `updateWorkspaceTokens`) | Write workspaces in new `{provider:'linear', credentials:{…}}` shape. `getAuthRouter()` already wired ([LIN-331](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-331/consumers-migrate-dashboard-call-sites-getauthrouter)). | n/a | blocked-by S1 |
| **S3** | `lib/render.js` | L286/L713 `'View in Linear →'` → `View in {displayName} →`; L312-313 un-pin `getProvider('linear').getCreateTaskUrl` (resolve provider from workspace) + `write`-gate "+ Add task"; L630-638 `comments`-gate Comments toggle; L608-610 `estimates`-gate `${estimate} pts`. | write, comments, estimates, displayName | blocked-by S0 **and** S1 (un-pin needs `workspace.provider`) |

| **S5** | `lib/prompt-templates.js`, `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (\~55 strings), **and** `lib/prompts/meta-prompt-template.js` | Parallel gating in templates. **CLAUDE.md two-paths rule: handwritten AND meta-prompt paths must change together.** | write, subtasks, displayName | blocked-by S0 |

### Completeness check — concept search, scope decisions

* `public/swipe.js` L424 `'View in Linear →'`, `public/foreman.js` L392/475/564 `title="… in Linear"` — **same user-facing display-string class as S3. In scope** (mark as S3-adjacent), else "don't hardcode Linear" is only half-done. May be split to a follow-up subtask but should not be silently dropped.
* `routes/workspace-api.js` (13×), `server.js` (5×), `lib/pipeline-state.js` (1×) direct `getProvider('linear')` **data-fetch** calls — **OUT of scope.** These are consumer re-pointing tracked under [LIN-306](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-306/unify-on-our-api-route-the-consumer-api-through-providers-retire-the) (per brief). [LIN-177](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-177/phase-3-source-tracking-and-multi-provider-rendering) owns *display/credential* coupling, not data-fetcher re-pointing.
* The 29 `workspace.accessToken` reads in `workspace-api.js` (+ pipeline.js, proxy.js test-mode) — **in scope as a back-compat accessor migration (S-readers)**, because they read the workspace credential shape S1 changes. Mitigated by S1's dual-read accessor so they need not all change big-bang.
* `lib/linear.js` shim — **leave intact** (settled Phase 2; `routes/proxy.js` still imports it; re-point tracked under [LIN-306](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-306/unify-on-our-api-route-the-consumer-api-through-providers-retire-the)).

## Cross-cutting concerns

1. **Capability access pattern** consumed by S3/S4/S5 — settle once in **S0**. The method-keyed `supports()` does not cover `estimates`/`subtasks`/UI-`write`, so prefer an explicit `provider.ui`/capability map over overloading `supports()`.
2. **Credential shape** (S1) written by S2, read by \~29 sites — one **dual-read accessor** shared by writers and readers during transition.
3. **Display name** source resolved once in S0; consumed by S3 (and prompts if desired).
4. `getCreateTaskUrl` **un-pin + write-gate** both live in S3 and share the `write` decision — keep consistent; the un-pin specifically needs `workspace.provider` from S1.
5. **Two-paths prompt parity** (CLAUDE.md) — S5 spans handwritten + meta-prompt; structural tests per `docs/prompt-change-validation.md`.

## Dependency arrows (→ copy 1:1 into `blocked-by` on breakdown)

* S1 → S2 → (credential readers)
* S1 → S3 (un-pin needs `workspace.provider`)
* S0 → S3, S4, S5
* S0 ∥ S1 (independent; can run in parallel)

## High-churn note

All surface files are high-churn (render.js, prompt-templates.js, meta-prompt-template.js at the 40-commit cap; template-defs 25). That churn protects **prompt completeness/scaling** ([LIN-260](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-260/scale-prompt-complexity-and-output-on-task-scale), [LIN-284](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-284/formatissuecontext-surface-silent-truncation-on-sibling-list-analog-of)) and **two-paths parity** (CLAUDE.md). This plan avoids regressing them by gating *around* existing structure (no restructuring), changing both prompt paths in lockstep, and adding structural tests.

## Session-fit: **NEEDS MULTIPLE SESSIONS → next action** `breakdown`

Four task groups + a prerequisite interface extension (S0) + a 29-site credential migration (S1/readers) + two prompt paths (S5). Subtasks = S0, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5 with the arrows above as `blocked-by` relations. S0 and S1 are the two roots (parallelizable); everything else hangs off them.

## Testing strategy

Per surface: **S3** — render permutations via a stub provider (write on/off, comments on/off, estimates on/off, displayName swap). **S4/S5** — prompt-output diffs Linear vs a non-Linear stub across **both** the handwritten and meta-prompt paths, plus structural tests from `docs/prompt-change-validation.md`. **S1/S2** — workspace read/write round-trip for the new `{provider, credentials}` shape **including back-compat reading a legacy** `accessToken`**-shaped workspace**. **Smoke** — existing E2E (`dashboard.spec.js`) confirms the Linear dashboard flow is byte-unchanged.

## Dependency — satisfied ✅ (Phase 2 / [LIN-176](https://linear.app/linearviewer/issue/LIN-176/phase-2-provider-interface-and-linear-provider) Done; foundation verified at HEAD `45bf490`)

**Blocker check — cleared. ✅ Next action: `plan`.**

Confirmed the blocking dependency **LIN-176 (Phase 2: Provider Interface & Linear Provider) is genuinely resolved**, in both Linear and the codebase. No `blocked` label was present, so none to remove; moved Todo → **In Progress** and updated the description's "Blocked by" note to "Dependency — satisfied."

**Linear evidence:** LIN-176 is **Done** (completed 2026-06-07T21:56Z). Both its subtasks are Done and merged to `main`: **LIN-330** (contract — interface + registry + Linear provider + `lib/linear.js` shim, PR #351) and **LIN-331** (dashboard consumers migrated onto the provider registry + `getAuthRouter`, PR #352). Its closing comment reports main CI green post-merge.

**Codebase evidence (verified at HEAD on `origin/main` @ `45bf490`, the LIN-331 #352 squash merge — not just the in-flight branch):**
- `lib/providers/interface.js` — `ProviderInterface` base class with a **capability descriptor** (`capabilities` getter + `supports(method)`), the full eventual surface declared (reads, writes, `search`/`states`/`labels`/`cycles`/`relations`), `NotImplementedError` for gated methods, and **`getAuthRouter()` / `getCreateTaskUrl()` as first-class methods** — exactly the foundation this phase (capability-aware rendering + provider-aware auth) builds on.
- `lib/providers/registry.js` — `registerProvider` / `getProvider`; the Linear provider self-registers at module load.
- `lib/providers/linear/index.js` — `LinearProvider extends ProviderInterface`, implements the 9 dashboard fetchers, `getAuthRouter()` (→ `createAuthRoutes`) and `getCreateTaskUrl()`, and calls `registerProvider(linearProvider)`.
- `lib/linear.js` — confirmed reduced to a thin re-export shim (the open question "delete vs keep" was settled as *keep*, since `routes/proxy.js` still imports it; re-pointed later by LIN-306).

**Staleness re-ground of LIN-177's own task surface (so the planner knows what's already in place vs. remaining):** the *foundation* is in place but the **Phase-3 work itself is unstarted** — it has NOT been pre-done by LIN-176/331:
- `render.js` still hardcodes **"View in Linear →"** (lines 286, 710-713); `getCreateTaskUrl` is wired but pinned to `getProvider('linear')` and **not** `write`-capability-gated yet.
- `routes/workspace.js` has **no `provider` / `credentials` field** yet — workspace model is still Linear-token-shaped.
- `prompt-formatters.js` carries **28 Linear/MCP references** with **no capability gating**; `prompt-templates.js` similarly ungated.
So all four task groups (generalize workspace model, capability-aware render, capability-aware prompts, provider-aware auth-route storage) remain genuinely open.

**Plan ready. → Next action: `breakdown`** (not `implement`).

Re-grounded at HEAD `caf1031` (≡ `origin/main` `45bf490`). The Phase-2 foundation is present and usable; Phase-3 work is genuinely unstarted, as the prior comment said.

**Session-fit: needs multiple sessions.** The plan in the description decomposes into 6 surfaces with arrows ready to copy 1:1 into `blocked-by` relations:

- **S0** (interface + Linear provider) and **S1** (workspace model) are the two parallelizable roots.
- **S2** ← S1; **S3** ← S0 **and** S1; **S4**, **S5** ← S0.

**Two findings that change the shape of the work** (so `breakdown` doesn't recreate the ticket's blind spots):

1. **The capability vocabulary the ticket assumes doesn't exist yet.** The Phase-2 `capabilities` descriptor is *method-keyed* (`fetchProjects`/`createIssue`/…), with no `write`/`comments`/`estimates`/`subtasks` flags and no human display name. Worse, Linear's writes are *declared-but-unimplemented this phase*, so gating "+ Add task" on a descriptor-derived `write` would **hide it for Linear** — a regression. Hence the prerequisite surface **S0** must define the UI/prompt capability surface + `displayName` first; it's where the real design decision lives.

2. **Blast radius is wider than the ticket's 4 files.** The workspace credential shape lives in `lib/workspace.js` + `routes/auth.js` (not `routes/workspace.js`) and is read at **~29 `workspace.accessToken` sites** in `workspace-api.js` et al. — mitigated by a dual-read back-compat accessor (S1). Out of scope and explicitly handed off: the `getProvider('linear')` **data-fetcher** re-pointing belongs to **LIN-306**; the `lib/linear.js` shim stays intact.

Strategy chosen: **close the contract gap (generalize the workspace model now)**, because deferring it routes around an *untracked* gap with no inheritor ticket — every queued provider (LIN-178/179/275) would otherwise pay the per-provider workaround tax.

## Parallelizable roots — ready to pick up immediately

The real design decision lives here (explicit `provider.ui` map vs. overloading `supports()`; UI-`write` tied to `getCreateTaskUrl`, **not** `supports('createIssue')`).
- **S1 (LIN-333)** — generalizes the workspace model with a dual-read accessor so the ~29 `workspace.accessToken` read sites migrate incrementally.

## Re-grounding / drift — none found
HEAD is `caf1031` (= the plan's HEAD; no commits since on any cited path). Spot-checked every pinned line and all referenced files exist with the cited content unchanged:
- `render.js` — `'View in Linear →'` at **L286** (project) & **L713** (issue); `getProvider('linear').getCreateTaskUrl` at **L313**; `${issue.estimate} pts` at **L609**; Comments toggle at **L632**. ✓

## Recommended next action
Pick up **S0 (LIN-332)** and/or **S1 (LIN-333)** — the two parallelizable roots. S0 should land the capability-surface shape first (it gates S3/S4/S5 and resolves the open design question); S1 can proceed concurrently.
